findings.text: record_on_disk[node] == probe-node compares the record against a value the test itself passed in, and line 117 written[0][held_at] == record_on_disk[held_at] compares two manifestations of one code-generated value, so both move together and hold whatever the code does; the durable guard is the independent observation at lines 106-107, which reddens at the base revision.

the census guard asserts only that a migrated site takes no bare flock, so removing exclusive_lock from reckon/crew/budget_reset.py::_locked or the two reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py writers and leaving no lock at all would pass both guard assertions; only the picker and catalogue migrations carry a behavioural cross-node test, so durability for two of the five sites rests on absence of flock rather than presence of the cross-node lock.
